profileEvidence.summary: Olde Boston Bulldogges are lively, outgoing dogs with a loyal streak and an interest in pleasing their owners. Their spirited character is paired with a willingness to learn. This modern breeding project aims to recreate the older Boston Bulldog type, with a muscular, athletic build, and is distinct from today’s Boston Terrier.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: Lively and outgoing, Olde Boston Bulldogges combine a loyal disposition with a spirited interest in pleasing their owners.
